metadata.name: prophet_games
metadata.description: Prophet games: Asset Race and Price Arena in one program

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin, or the configured race operator.

accounts.name: creator_earnings
docs: Platform races always credit the admin, whoever signs.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can
front-run the deploy and take the admin role.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: ActivityPaused
errors.msg: New games and bets are paused

errors.name: InvalidTitle
errors.msg: Title must be 1-64 bytes with at least one visible character

errors.name: AssetNotApproved
errors.msg: Asset is not approved for this category

errors.name: AmountZero
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MissingSignatureInstruction
errors.msg: Expected an Ed25519 signature instruction immediately before this one

errors.name: InvalidAttestationSigner
errors.msg: Price attestation was not signed by the game's oracle signer

errors.name: InvalidAttestationBoundary
errors.msg: Price attestation does not prove the target time boundary

errors.name: MissingAssetPrice
errors.msg: Price attestation is missing a required asset

errors.name: InvalidOracleDecimals
errors.msg: Oracle price decimals do not match the asset

errors.name: DuplicateAsset
errors.msg: Asset is already in this race

errors.name: DuplicatePriceSource
errors.msg: Price source is already used by another asset in this race

errors.name: DurationNotApproved
errors.msg: Race duration is not an approved preset

errors.name: InvalidRaceStatus
errors.msg: Race is not in the required status

errors.name: LobbyAdditionAlreadyUsed
errors.msg: This wallet already added an asset to the lobby

errors.name: StakeBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Stake is below the race minimum

errors.name: WrongAsset
errors.msg: A wallet can back only one asset per race

errors.name: StartTooEarly
errors.msg: Race cannot start before betting ends

errors.name: NotLosingPosition
errors.msg: Only a losing position can be closed this way

errors.name: NotEntered
errors.msg: Wallet has not entered this arena

errors.name: InvalidPrediction
errors.msg: Prediction must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidStake
errors.msg: Stake is outside the arena limits

types.name: ApprovedAsset
docs: Protocol-reviewed asset, shared by both games. `price_source` identifies
the frozen pool the price service reads; attestation entries key on it.

types.name: Arena
docs: One arena. The account itself escrows every native-SOL stake placed on it,
and holds all (at most ten) entries so resolution fits in one transaction.

fields.name: oracle_signer
docs: Snapshotted at creation so later signer rotation cannot affect this arena.

fields.name: remaining_liability
docs: Payouts or refunds still owed to players from this escrow.

types.name: CommunityPolicy
docs: Rules every community race inherits; the creator picks only title,
category, an approved duration, the stake currency and initial assets.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover; `Pubkey::default()` when none is pending.

fields.name: oracle_signer
docs: Ed25519 key whose pool attestations new games will trust.

fields.name: race_operator
docs: Optional hot key (the race scheduler) that may create platform races
and nothing else; their creator fees still accrue to the admin.
`Pubkey::default()` when unset.

fields.name: paused
docs: Pauses only creation and new bets/entries. Lifecycle, claims and refunds stay open.

types.name: CreatorEarnings
docs: Creator revenue for one (stake mint, creator) across races and arenas.
Pull-based so a resolve never fails because a creator cannot receive funds.

fields.name: prediction
docs: Not secret: account data is public. Clients hide it during the lobby.

fields.name: prediction_seq
docs: Arena-local order of the last prediction change; lower ranks first on
equal error. A pure top-up keeps it.

fields.name: rank
docs: 1-based final rank, `NO_RANK` until resolved.

types.name: EntryChanged
docs: Deliberately omits the prediction (it is still public in account data).

fields.name: stake_mint
docs: `NATIVE_SOL` or an accepted SPL mint.

types.name: Race
docs: One race. The account itself escrows every native-SOL stake placed on it.

fields.name: oracle_signer
docs: Snapshotted at creation so later signer rotation cannot affect this race.

fields.name: remaining_liability
docs: Stakes and winnings still owed to bettors from this escrow.

fields.name: return_value
docs: Percentage return scaled by `RETURN_SCALE`.

types.name: StakeMintConfig
docs: An accepted stake currency: native SOL (`NATIVE_SOL`) or an SPL mint. Its
limits apply to community races and arenas created with it.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Protocol fee balance for one stake mint, shared by both games: lamports
above rent for native SOL, or the balance of its vault for an SPL mint.
